title: ३५ वर्षपछि PHP का गम्भीर सुरक्षा कमजोरी सार्वजनिक, नेपालसहित विश्वभरका सरकारी वेबसाइट डाउन
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । विश्वभर व्यापक रूपमा प्रयोग हुने प्रोग्रामिङ भाषा PHP मा गम्भीर सुरक्षा कमजोरी फेला परेपछि युरोपसहित विभिन्न क्षेत्रका सरकारी वेबसाइटहरू बन्द गरिएका छन् । नेपालका पनि सरकारी वेबसाइटहरु खुलेका छैनन् । कमजोरी सार्वजनिक भएसँगै ह्याकरहरूले त्यसको दुरुपयोग गर्न सक्ने जोखिम बढेपछि वेबसाइट सञ्चालकहरू आफ्नो प्रणाली सुरक्षित बनाउन जुटेका छन्। नेपालमा अहिले सरकारी विदा भएकाले यसबारे कुनै अपडेट आएको छैन । रोयटर्सका अनुसार एज्ए विकासकर्ताहरूले बुधबार सुरक्षा कमजोरी समाधान गर्ने आपत्कालीन अपडेट जारी गर्दै सबै प्रयोगकर्तालाई तत्काल प्रणाली अद्यावधिक गर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) को प्रयोगबाट वर्षौँदेखि सफ्टवेयरमा लुकेका यी कमजोरी पत्ता लागेको हो । प्रविधि कम्पनीहरूले केही ह्याकरले कमजोरीको दुरुपयोग गर्न थालिसकेको चेतावनी दिएका छन् । सुरक्षा विज्ञहरूले कमजोरीको समाधान सार्वजनिक भइसकेको र एआई उपकरणबाट त्यसको प्राविधिक पक्ष विश्लेषण गर्न सजिलो भएकाले इन्टरनेटमा रहेका असुरक्षित सर्भरमाथि आक्रमण तीव्र हुन सक्ने बताएका छन् । साइबर सुरक्षा अनुसन्धान संस्था टीएलपीःब्ल्याकका सहसंस्थापक कोस्टिन राइउले यस अवस्थालाई कमजोरीको दुरुपयोग गर्न ह्याकरहरूबीच भइरहेको दौडका रूपमा व्याख्या गरेका छन् । उनका अनुसार अब इन्टरनेटमा रहेका कमजोर सर्भरहरू सामूहिक रूपमा नियन्त्रणमा लिने जोखिम छ । सन् १९९० को दशकको सुरुआतमा विकसित PHP भाषा वर्डप्रेस, ड्रुपल, जुम्ला र म्याजेन्टाजस्ता लोकप्रिय वेबसाइट प्रणालीमा प्रयोग हुन्छ । त्यसैले यसको सुरक्षा कमजोरीले इन्टरनेटका ठूलो हिस्सालाई असर गर्न सक्ने विज्ञहरूको चेतावनी छ । ड्रुपल एसोसिएसनकी अन्तरिम प्रमुख कार्यकारी टिफनी फारिसका अनुसार पछिल्ला २० वर्षमा जारी भएका PHP का संस्करण प्रयोग गर्ने सर्भरहरू जोखिममा पर्न सक्छन् । इन्टरनेट इन्टेलिजेन्स कम्पनी सेन्सिसको तथ्यांकअनुसार PHP चलाइरहेका २६ लाख होस्टमध्ये करिब १५ लाखमा अझै सुरक्षा समाधान उपलब्ध नभएको संस्करण प्रयोग भइरहेको छ । विश्वभरका साइबर सुरक्षा निकायले प्रयोगकर्तालाई तत्काल नयाँ अपडेट जडान गर्न वा त्यसो गर्न नसकिए वेबसाइट अस्थायी रूपमा अफलाइन राख्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । Kathmandu. Government websites in various regions, including Europe, have been shut down after a serious security flaw was discovered in the programming language PHP, which is widely used around the world. Government websites in Nepal are also not open. Website operators are scrambling to secure their systems as the vulnerability has become public, raising the risk that hackers could exploit it. There is no update on this as it is a government holiday in Nepal. According to Reuters, the developers of AJ on Wednesday issued an emergency update to fix the security flaw, urging all users to update their systems immediately. The flaws, which have been hidden in the software for years, were discovered using artificial intelligence (AI). Technology companies have warned that some hackers have begun exploiting the vulnerability. Security experts say that attacks on unprotected servers on the Internet could accelerate as fixes for the vulnerability are made public and AI tools are able to analyze its technical aspects more easily. Costin Raiu, co-founder of cybersecurity research firm TLP:Black, described the situation as a race among hackers to exploit vulnerabilities. He said there is now a risk of collective control of vulnerable servers on the internet. Developed in the early 1990s, PHP is used in popular website systems such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, and Magenta. Experts warn that its security vulnerabilities could affect a large portion of the internet. According to Tiffany Faris, interim CEO of the Drupal Association, servers using versions of PHP released in the last 20 years may be at risk. According to data from Internet intelligence company Sensys, out of the 2.6 million hosts running AJAX, about 1.5 million are using a version for which a security fix is not yet available. Cybersecurity agencies around the world have urged users to install new updates immediately or, if unable to do so, to temporarily take the website offline.

Security experts say that attacks on unprotected servers on the Internet could accelerate as fixes for the vulnerability are made public and AI tools are able to analyze its technical aspects more easily. He said there is now a risk of collective control of vulnerable servers on the internet. Developed in the early 1990s, PHP is used in popular website systems such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, and Magenta. साइबर सुरक्षा अनुसन्धान संस्था टीएलपीःब्ल्याकका सहसंस्थापक कोस्टिन राइउले यस अवस्थालाई कमजोरीको दुरुपयोग गर्न ह्याकरहरूबीच भइरहेको दौडका रूपमा व्याख्या गरेका छन् । उनका अनुसार अब इन्टरनेटमा रहेका कमजोर सर्भरहरू सामूहिक रूपमा नियन्त्रणमा लिने जोखिम छ ।

सन् १९९० को दशकको सुरुआतमा विकसित PHP भाषा वर्डप्रेस, ड्रुपल, जुम्ला र म्याजेन्टाजस्ता लोकप्रिय वेबसाइट प्रणालीमा प्रयोग हुन्छ । त्यसैले यसको सुरक्षा कमजोरीले इन्टरनेटका ठूलो हिस्सालाई असर गर्न सक्ने विज्ञहरूको चेतावनी छ ।

ड्रुपल एसोसिएसनकी अन्तरिम प्रमुख कार्यकारी टिफनी फारिसका अनुसार पछिल्ला २० वर्षमा जारी भएका PHP का संस्करण प्रयोग गर्ने सर्भरहरू जोखिममा पर्न सक्छन् ।

इन्टरनेट इन्टेलिजेन्स कम्पनी सेन्सिसको तथ्यांकअनुसार PHP चलाइरहेका २६ लाख होस्टमध्ये करिब १५ लाखमा अझै सुरक्षा समाधान उपलब्ध नभएको संस्करण प्रयोग भइरहेको छ ।

विश्वभरका साइबर सुरक्षा निकायले प्रयोगकर्तालाई तत्काल नयाँ अपडेट जडान गर्न वा त्यसो गर्न नसकिए वेबसाइट अस्थायी रूपमा अफलाइन राख्न आग्रह गरेका छन् ।

Government websites in various regions, including Europe, have been shut down after a serious security flaw was discovered in the programming language PHP, which is widely used around the world. Government websites in Nepal are also not open. Website operators are scrambling to secure their systems as the vulnerability has become public, raising the risk that hackers could exploit it. There is no update on this as it is a government holiday in Nepal. According to Reuters, the developers of AJ on Wednesday issued an emergency update to fix the security flaw, urging all users to update their systems immediately. The flaws, which have been hidden in the software for years, were discovered using artificial intelligence (AI). Technology companies have warned that some hackers have begun exploiting the vulnerability. Security experts say that attacks on unprotected servers on the Internet could accelerate as fixes for the vulnerability are made public and AI tools are able to analyze its technical aspects more easily. Costin Raiu, co-founder of cybersecurity research firm TLP:Black, described the situation as a race among hackers to exploit vulnerabilities. He said there is now a risk of collective control of vulnerable servers on the internet. Developed in the early 1990s, PHP is used in popular website systems such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, and Magenta. Experts warn that its security vulnerabilities could affect a large portion of the internet. According to Tiffany Faris, interim CEO of the Drupal Association, servers using versions of PHP released in the last 20 years may be at risk. According to data from Internet intelligence company Sensys, out of the 2.6 million hosts running AJAX, about 1.5 million are using a version for which a security fix is not yet available. Cybersecurity agencies around the world have urged users to install new updates immediately or, if unable to do so, to temporarily take the website offline.
